'''Pol Prentiss''' was the brother of [[Cassio Prentiss]]. Sometime before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Pol and Cassio attended a party held in the [[Grand Ballroom (Aldera Royal Palace)|Grand Ballroom]] of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]]. During the event, the brothers argued over which of them had cheated at [[greenputt]], amusing both [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and her companion [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], who were hiding beneath a [[Marble/Legends|marble]] staircase to watch the party.<ref name="Hostage" />
